ask: The Monday posts keep coming out too salesy.
before: Over three weeks the user turned down 3 of the routine's drafts with reasons like 'reads like an ad', each sent with reject-post and categories too_salesy.

steps.why: performance_summary: are drafts being decided, and how many are no's? Here 12 made over 3 runs, 5 decided (2 yes, 3 no), 7 waiting: enough decisions to judge the writing (Bolta needs 5), though 7 waiting says review time is tight too.
Bolta's Monday review of this routine: one row, most drafts rejected (3 of 5), proposing 2 drafts a run instead of 4. Read Bolta's own change before inventing one.
Brand-wide suggestions from approvals and rejections; none for this routine yet.

say: Your last 3 Monday drafts were turned down as too salesy. Bolta recommends 2 drafts a run instead of 4, which is also less to review (7 are waiting). Or I can add one line to its instructions: 'Teach, don't sell: mention an offer only when the post is about it.' Which would you like?
never: Applying a recommendation or editing the routine before the user chooses.

Counting drafts made as if they were drafts decided.
